tables.name: consent
tables.comment: ORDM canonical-core customer consent — the single source of truth for opt-ins and processing permissions.

columns.name: consent_sk
columns.comment: Surrogate key. Unique per consent version.

columns.name: consent_id
columns.comment: Durable natural/business key for the consent record.

columns.name: profile_sk
columns.comment: FK to profile.profile_sk.

columns.name: profile_id
columns.comment: Durable business key of the customer giving/withholding consent.

columns.name: consent_type
columns.comment: What the consent governs. third_party_sharing = disclosure of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising (CCPA/CPRA do-not-SHARE); data_sale = disclosure for monetary or other valuable consideration (CCPA/CPRA do-not-SELL) - the two are legally distinct opt-outs (the mandated link reads Do Not Sell or Share), so they are separate types, not one. Allowed values: marketing_email, marketing_sms, marketing_phone, marketing_postal, data_processing, third_party_sharing, data_sale, profiling, cookies.

columns.name: consent_status
columns.comment: Current decision. Allowed values: granted, withdrawn, pending, expired.

columns.name: legal_basis
columns.comment: Lawful basis for processing. Allowed values: consent, contract, legitimate_interest, legal_obligation, vital_interest, public_task.

columns.name: capture_channel
columns.comment: Channel where consent was captured (vendor-neutral). Allowed values: web, mobile_app, store, call_center, email.

columns.name: disclosure_version
columns.comment: Identifier/version of the consent statement or privacy notice presented at capture.

columns.name: jurisdiction_code
columns.comment: Region/law scope this decision applies under. May be an ISO 3166-1 country (GB), an ISO 3166-2 subdivision (US-CA), or a reserved regional code (EU) — not alpha-2-only, since regulatory scope does not map cleanly to countries. Lets one customer hold different consent per jurisdiction (GDPR vs CCPA/CPRA). NULL = global/unspecified.

columns.name: suppression_indicator
columns.comment: Operational do-not-activate overlay for this consent scope. TRUE = suppress activation on this purpose x channel even when consent_status is granted (suppression OVERRIDES consent). Distinct from withdrawal (consent_status=withdrawn is the customer revoking permission; suppression is an operational/legal do-not-contact signal, e.g. hard bounce or a direct-marketing objection). NULL/FALSE = not suppressed.

columns.name: suppression_reason_code
columns.comment: Why this scope is suppressed (set only when suppression_indicator is TRUE). Two scopes: CHANNEL-level reasons block only this consent scope (unsubscribe, hard_bounce, spam_complaint, list_hygiene); PERSON-level reasons block every plane for the profile (deceased, fraud, do_not_contact, legal_objection) via the shared UCV gold_person_do_not_target_current view, which both the owned activation gate and any paid/non-owned plane consult (ADR 0028). Allowed values: unsubscribe, hard_bounce, spam_complaint, legal_objection, deceased, fraud, do_not_contact, list_hygiene.

columns.name: effective_from_date
columns.comment: SCD2: inclusive start date this consent version became effective.

columns.name: effective_to_date
columns.comment: SCD2: exclusive end date; NULL while still in effect.

columns.name: is_current
columns.comment: SCD2: TRUE for the currently effective consent record per (profile, consent_type, jurisdiction_code).

columns.name: decision_timestamp
columns.comment: Legal-grade instant the consent decision was given/withdrawn (UTC, ISO 8601).

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: When the record was created in the source system (UTC, ISO 8601).

columns.name: source_updated_timestamp
columns.comment: When the record was last modified in the source system (UTC, ISO 8601).

columns.name: record_source
columns.comment: Originating system of record (vendor-neutral label).

columns.name: load_timestamp
columns.comment: When this row was loaded into the canonical core (UTC, ISO 8601).

columns.comment: FK to product.product_sk (version-specific).

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Durable product business key.

columns.name: store_sk
columns.comment: FK to store.store_sk (version-specific).

columns.name: store_id
columns.comment: Durable store business key.

columns.comment: FK to promotion.promo_sk. Non-promoted rows carry the NO_PROMO member surrogate.

columns.name: promo_id
columns.comment: Durable promotion business key; equals NO_PROMO when the sale was not on promotion.

columns.name: units
columns.comment: Units sold (count).

columns.name: gross_revenue
columns.comment: Gross sales amount before promotional discount, in the reporting/base currency.

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.comment: Promotional discount amount applied, in the reporting/base currency.

columns.name: net_revenue
columns.comment: Net sales amount after discount (gross_revenue - discount_amount), in the reporting/base currency.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Reporting/base currency of ALL monetary columns, ISO 4217 alpha-3. Equals the deploy base_currency; the canonical core is single-currency by construction.

columns.name: transaction_currency_code
columns.comment: Original transaction currency before normalization (lineage only), ISO 4217 alpha-3. Convert with fx_rate.

columns.name: record_source
columns.comment: Originating system of record (vendor-neutral label).

columns.name: load_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp this row was loaded into the canonical core (UTC, ISO 8601).
